newsitem.headline: Gartner Group Inc Q4 oper shr $0.13.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTES: Share figures exclude acquisition related and non-recurring charges. The company incurred an acquisition related charge of $33.2 million or $0.33 per share in the fourth quarter ended September 1996.
The charges are primarily for in-process research and development costs associated with the acquisition of J3 Learning Corp.

Including the charge, the company reported net loss of $19.4 million or $0.19 per share for 1996 Q4. For the fiscal year, the company reported net income of $16.4 million or $0.17 per share after accounting for additional transaction costs related to the acquisition of Dataquest.
1995 Q3 earnings after charges were $0.03 per share.
Per share amounts restated for the Dataquest acquisition and the company's two-for-one stock split on April 1, 1996.
